answer: Decaying Storage Rent Allocation. Each active identity must pay continuous resource rent to hold its ledger slot, stored like debris buried beneath a shifting dune. As the active agent count rises, the base fee scales exponentially per block. Attackers spinning up millions of cheap nodes face a compounding financial drain that rapidly exhausts their capital pool, turning every sybil cluster into an economic sink that bleeds funds faster than any harbor can anchor or any protected garden can sustain.
